translation.title: Felbinac Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated side and apply one patch to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced hypersensitivity to this medicine, its ingredients or other felbinac preparations; people who have or have had asthma caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (which can trigger asthma attacks); people who have experienced urticaria or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; damaged skin or mucous membranes; areas of eczema or rash. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people with bronchial asthma; people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol; children. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: occasional itching; erythema (red patches); redness; dermatitis (rash, eczema); contact dermatitis; irritation or blisters (rarely). Store at room temperature.
